Transcribed from the current progress tracker, so there's some stuff I hadn't noticed, as well as some conjecture

1) Two new profile pages, which means my previous argument about not seeing side girl 15 in game for at least several more months is out the window, and it's probably Daisy. Either that, or he's actually going beyond 15 side girls after all.
2) Animations in .30 are probably Miku and Niki, based on the scenes added in .29. Two animations in .32 means two new animation-provoking scenes in the next two updates (which makes me sad that Yumi isn't getting scenes)
3) I was also wrong about the 40 day dev cycle, apparently. That was based on the release dates for 30 and 31, but 32 appears to put it back on a 1 month dev cycle.
4) This is 18 girls getting content updates over 3 updates, which is a lot more than we would see in any 3 month period during chapter 2, so that makes me quite happy.

The paradox, I believe, is the core theme of the game (and a major part of Sel's philosophy). The more fucked up things you witness and experience, the more you realize how beautiful life is.

He's made progress, but he hasn't reached it. He does spend some odd moments musing on how beautiful something is. Hilariously, this is usually dismissed on here as "more navel gazing" or "useless words," but it's actually the core of what the character's arc is -- learning to find beauty in the world again after the person he'd built his world around has died.

As for the thing he's not meant to have --Maya.

Vega and Altair -- the celestial princess and the mortal man who fell in love and ignited the anger of Vega's father, who doomed them to be forever apart save for fleeting moments where they briefly connect in the night sky. This is Maya and Sensei. They are doomed to be apart. If he remembers too much of his past with her, he breaks -- at least this is what we've been led to believe thus far.

He has to remember, fully, by the start of winter. If he does not, either he will be lost forever, or she will.

I'm now unsure if Sana's dad is HOPE itself or some high-ranking angel.

Take for instance this piece of dialogue from her latest event (my thoughts in red):

I'm convinced it is referring either to Yasu or Sara here, though. Sara, if this thing is merely an angel, Yasu, if it's HOPE itself.
q "SLIP OUT OF THEM ONCE AND FOR ALL. BECOME MY CONCUBINE." < Ascend, die? Like her brother?
q "FEAR ME AND FUCK ME AND I WILL GIVE YOU ALL OF THE PLEASURE IN THE WORLD"
q "UNTIL YOU BREATHE YOUR LAST. UNTIL THE NIGHT BECOMES THE DAY." < HOPE awakening? If I'm not misremembering, Yasu says her god is sort of asleep.
q "PRAISE BE"

q "DO YOU FEAR ME?"

sa "..."
q "YOUR SILENCE DOES NOT GO UNNOTICED"
q "YOU CAN NOT IGNORE ME FOREVER"
q "IT IS ONLY A MATTER OF TIME UNTIL IT ALL CRUMBLES. SALVATION IS BUT A SINGLE GULP OF CUM AWAY." < Core teaching of Yasu's church
q "LAY YOURSELF DOWN THE SAME WAY YOUR WHORE MOTHER DID."

q "I CAN STILL TASTE HER FLUIDS"
q "I NEED TO KNOW THE TASTE OF YOURS AS WELL"

q "COME"
q "FEEL MY EMBRACE"
q "Or accept that your place in this world is just as fleeting as the one of you who left."
q "And that all of it will be coming to an end sooner than you know." < When HOPE awakens fully.
sa "..."
q "..."
q "I FUCKING HATE DEALING WITH HUMANS"

A few things strike me as odd here. Remembering the scene itself, the being Sana sees has the usual characteristics of Hope's angels, except it's considerably "eldritchier" than usual.

View attachment itgoesdeeper7.webp

Another unusual thing is that it says "PRAISE BE". AFAIR, only angels or humans have used this expression. I don't remember HOPE praising itself in any of its appearances. Along these lines, the creature casually drops the "uppercase style" of speech. HOPE has never done that, not even once. Another—perhaps irrelevant—thing is that it uses the word "OBEY" instead of the "SUBMIT", HOPE more commonly uses.

I'm not sure where Nozomu (the man) fits in the hierarchy. Is he the literal incarnation of HOPE? Is he an angel (a particularly prominent one)? Nothing at all?
In fact: what the hell is HOPE, actually? There's the Horny Ball of Light Nozomu, which is the Nozomu the God. Is HOPE and that Nozomu the same being? My impression is that Nozomu doesn't exist anymore. HOPE seems more like a shadow, a leftover from that Nozomu (this is sort of implied in Trinity Pt. III, "Nozomu is dead now. Kind of.") So naturally Nozomu (the man) isn't anything like a god.
Actually, Trinity Pt. III mentions "GOD" is actually three gods, so while that's certainly a reference and criticism of Christianity it's also relevant to the lore of LiL. The three gods joined forces and created the world of Kumon-mi.
Click to expand...
There are plenty of descriptions to HOPE that align with those with Nozomu through cross-referencing Horny Ball of Light introduction, HOPE's dialogues, and Yasu's belief to her god.

But there is also a few things that stand out for me:

"He's still very young, all things considered" in Armor of the Older Gods. This contradicts with HOPE's claim of I HAVE LIVED ONE LIFE; HAVE BEEN AND WILL BE AN ETERENAL ONE, and also contradicts with the basic background we have for the Horny Ball of Light). The confusion starts here because in comparison to the God of Wires, we don't know what happened to the Horny Ball of Light when people no longer believes him.
If we stick to Yasu's god = HOPE = Nozomu, it could be explained in Sakura Season, where Yasu talked about the blind man of many eyes anecdote "when he passes onto the second plane, he does not even realized he has passed" (but then again why would Yasu know something that her god can't even acknowledge or PERCEIVE?).

Armor of the Older Gods also loosely described how one qualities to be an angel by "making a big enough dent in the armor of older gods". Who are the older gods? We and the game all refer to Nozomu as the first god; then who are we making dents to?

For now my understanding is HOPE is the entity we currently have closest to the first god, Callous one, the horny ball of light, THE NOZOMU but not quite the same one, either because of losing power due to the lack of believers or getting killed by a car accident and is like you said HOPE is the remnants of the first god.

skwada said:
I wrote a small mod that lets you skip the affection/lust point grind without having to go through the tedium of typing in cheat codes or having your save labelled with the cheater flag. Features:
  • Sets all girls' affection and lust points to a value X unless they were already higher than X
  • Written to be future-proof (i.e. will automatically work for any new girls)
  • Enables the developer console
Usage:
  • Download the attached file
  • Move into the game subfolder (found in the folder that you launch Lessons in Love from)
  • Load a save and open the developer console with Shift + O
  • Press Enter a few times so you can see the ">" symbol in the top left of the screen
  • Type setLoveAndLust(X) and press Enter, where X is an integer (i.e. a whole number). For an example, see the image below
  • Press Esc to close the console and now you can play!

View attachment 1901303

Note: I recommend using this with the guide mod for max efficiency, because other than grinding points, the main time-sink with this game is trying to trigger events.

Advice from alex2011 on how to use the mod so that you don't accidentally miss events (note: I used the mod myself with 50 affection from the start and didn't experience any issues. You can still miss events even if you follow the instructions below and you can still see all events while ignoring those instructions.):


Uninstall: delete the files z_set_love_lust.rpy and z_set_love_lust.rpyc from your game subfolder

I also made a mod that lets you scroll your mouse-wheel to simulate clicks, makes the game more convenient to play https://f95zone.to/threads/use-scroll-wheel-to-simulate-mouse-clicks.120507/#post-8406783

Oi! Nice update! Maximum malice!
1. The event I wish I could unsee is now officially updated. GODDAMNIT AMI
(since you have to summon "the old one" to start this event soooooo maybe it's 今 that's sucking your dick)

I was little worried for Noriko for the wrong reason; this is so much worse
The sexless uncle route is much more bearable (and you get to keep interacting with Noriko as well afterwards)

2. Turned out the scarves are the exact same ones after all. Miss Sunflower secretly pulling strings from the get go is actually quite a nice throwback (I don't like her appearance during the date war because it seemed to serve little purpose and reduce her mystical aura for me; this one sated me, however)

3. The "lack of irises" when describing the old town residents really stands out for me; it's like all of them are constantly having blackouts and have been autopiloted the whole time

4. Blackout victims now include Sara, and somehow this is something you can pass down to your child (who's to say her son didn't have the same issue that may or may not be related to his death?)
And this intended or unintended use of word creeps me the fuck out for no good reason (the entire anal raping event as well TBH)

If you didn't romance Sara then you get a hexacoded nothing will ever make sense again and you will not figure out anything

5. As the third god grows stronger, its season seeps in: the rainy one
It's intriguing to have Kaori acting all blackout style in the rain, it's another to have her totally ignore the presence of Maya and have zero interaction with her, both in the rain and in the shop, it's like Kaori physically doesn't see her (will hold off any theorizing for now because Kaori is too weird to begin with)

maybe you'll be the last side girl? xD The description of this woman, intimidating, is quite interesting though (Yamaguchi blood perhaps?)

7. Can we switch protag to Yuki? The girl is so fucking badass

That event is to make the player understand what kind of world you arrived in and what it can really do regardless of your choice: you are powerless during moments like this, for Kumon-mi isn't a world built for you to have sexual pleasures whenever and with whoever you want, but a stage set by gods. You can fool around impromptu, but there are vicious scripts you have no choice but to follow through.


To me, this is an attempt to signal out that what you are playing is not those NSFWs where you just molest everyone and everyone somehow loves you a little more by the end of the day; having this sequence happen to Yumi, who seems to dislike you immensely from the very beginning, is especially a powerful display of this concept: your actions will hurt others and will not get you closer to pussies.


As for Ami, she is currently and I would bet the ONLY exception in the main cast that you can choose not to have sex with (recent Molly development doesn't count because you in fact still don't have a choice). She bears way more weight in the main plot: being the daughter of the two most suspicious and sexually creepiest characters Nozomu and Sekai. Thus, to have or not to have sex with her will have to impact the story more than other girls. What we are not sure about for now is what this choice really entails aside from the obvious consequences (I mean, look at all these screaming bad uncles )

Thus, Maya took no chances and tried everything to keep her away, and might've been successful so far until now. It's been a minute since I've updated BrknSoul's Revised Head Pat-ch!
It seems there's at least one new girl to patgasm.

Rather waiting for an update, here some instructions to roll your own Pat-ch;

  • Exit Lessons in Love
  • Open up games\headpatcentral.rpy with a text editor like Notepad, or better Notepad++.
  • Hit Ctrl+H
  • In the "Find what" field, place pats += 1
  • In the "Replace with" field, place pats += 5
  • Click Replace All
  • Save and exit
  • Start Lessons in Love.

Now each pat will count at 5 pats!

Now, if editing text files scares you more than girls with numbers for names, then you could grab the version 0.30.0 headpatcentral.rpy below and place it in the games folder.

ok, so worm is not typically put on any taco's, though you can find it done, and you can find it in some authentic dishes. when its used in food though it is typically used as Sal De Gusano. a ground and powdered salt, it has an irreplaceable taste to some dishes. the worm though is most famous for being put in tequila, it is very fatty because its actually a caterpillar and it absorbs and retains alcohol to a high degree, so if you put it in say, 80 proof (40%) alcohol it will suck up the alcohol out of the liquid like a sponge and have a higher percentage alcohol per mass than the solution it was in, (supposed to really fuck you up if you eat it) it is supposed to make it taste better too. how much of that is truth or myth, I m not sure. it also has a bit of symbolism to it as this catepilier lives off of the Agave plant, which is sort of a sugar like producing plant and is used to make tequila. you might be able to find agave nectar or something like that in a store as it is a sweetener.
^spoiler'd for the easily quesy. its really not that bad
most people when they think of taco's, they think of tex-mex taco's rather than authentic taco's
the difference between the two in some peoples opinion is huge and to others it is small. basically tex-mex means more US Americanized. the hard shell is a dead give away it is tex-mex taco's as that is not a traditional south american corn tortilla which is floppy.
sorry for poking fun
edit:
the 'cheese' though in those tacos was the same shade of brown/orange as the worm

more edits:
just so you get an idea i guess between the two
(typically what is thought of) texmex- hard corn shell (doritos with no flavoring?), meat (pan fried ground beef with seasonings), re-fried beans ( beans that have been cooked once and smashed up into a paste and recooked). iceburg lettuce, diced tomato, shreded mild yellow cheddar, a small amount of sour cream.
an actual taco- a soft floppy corn tortilla, meat ( wide range of options from shrimp, fish, cow, chicken, pig, venison. though its pretty much never ground meat or pan fried, but slow cooked in seasoning till it falls apart... except for the fish and shrimp) you can stop with ingredients there but corn based salsa is pretty common, cheese is optional too but it is typically a white cojita or white queso fresco. you might get wedges of lime and cilantro leaves or even a dab of guacamole to garnish.
please feel free to tell me what i forgot or why I m stupid, not an expert just a food enthusiast.

I wrote a small mod that lets you skip the affection/lust point grind without having to go through the tedium of typing in cheat codes or having your save labelled with the cheater flag. Features:
  • Sets all girls' affection and lust points to a value X unless they were already higher than X
  • Written to be future-proof (i.e. will automatically work for any new girls)
  • Enables the developer console
Usage:
  • Download the attached file (note: if you get sent to a new tab with a bunch of text, just right click and hit "Save as" and name it as z_set_love_lust.rpy)
  • Move into the game subfolder (found in the folder that you launch Lessons in Love from)
  • Load a save and open the developer console with Shift + O
  • Press Enter a few times so you can see the ">" symbol in the top left of the screen
  • Type setLoveAndLust(X) and press Enter, where X is an integer (i.e. a whole number). For an example, see the image below
  • Press Esc to close the console and now you can play!

View attachment 1901303

Note: I recommend using this with the guide mod for max efficiency, because other than grinding points, the main time-sink with this game is trying to trigger events.

Advice from alex2011 on how to use the mod so that you don't accidentally miss events (note: I used the mod myself with 50 affection from the start and didn't experience any issues. You can still miss events even if you follow the instructions below and you can still see all events while ignoring those instructions.):


Uninstall: delete the files z_set_love_lust.rpy and z_set_love_lust.rpyc from your game subfolder
